{{Header Nav|game=Doom}}

Press the button in the middle, get the mega armor, and head outside. You should see a bunch of rocket ammo, a rocket launcher, and soul spheres (+100 health). On the higher difficulty levels, you will see lost souls. Either use the chaingun or plasma rifle if they annoy you or force them to monster infight with the Cyberdemon to distract. Be cautious with rockets while lost souls are available because a rocket blast hitting a lost soul at point blank range could cost you a lot of health, if not outright kill you. 

The Cyberdemon has 4000 health. This is equal to 355-415 Chaingun bullets, 51-60 Shotgun blasts, 36-52 rockets (Cyberdemon is immune to blast damage), and 171-186 Plasma Rifle shots. However you wish to fight the Cyberdemon is up to you.

Note that not using Strafe Left or Strafe Right will make the level much longer than it should.  

If you only have the 50 bullets and pistol, this battle will be much harder to deal with and expects a near perfect run. You only have 2 soul spheres and 1 blue armor. Leave the central area by the east exit to get the rocket launcher.  The north exit will have many rockets available, while the west and south have a supercharge in case you get injured.  

=== Secrets ===
There are no secrets on the map.  

=== Deatmatch ===
There is no changes to deathmatch, and as such, it is not a good map: There is only one rocket launcher.
